Example Aroma Chemicals starts up new citral unit in Exampletown

Exampletown, 29 August 2024

Example Aroma Chemicals Ltd. (fictitious company, test fixture) today announced the successful start-up of its new citral plant at the Exampletown Chemical Park. The plant has an annual capacity of 48,000 tonnes and uses the company’s own isoprenol route.

Construction began in 2022. The unit also supplies the company’s linalool line.
